json.overall_experience: This reviewer, a copywriter and marketing consultant, found Slack to be an indispensable tool for daily team communication and project collaboration. Its channel-based organization helped streamline discussions and file sharing, contributing significantly to their small team's efficiency over more than two years. While occasionally overwhelming with notifications, the overall benefit to their workflow was substantial, making it a highly recommended platform.
